scope: developer-time Claude Code skills; no runtime AI agent or customer data

cases.prompt: In this ipix-open branch, plan how to port the real iPix Production Planner and its six-outfit shoot workflow into the bundled Mastra service without calling the legacy deployed app. Show current files, auth, and QA memory proof before coding.
cases.expected: Identifies standalone target, native agent-mastra and harness registry, source-only legacy dependency closure, isolated QA memory and authentication STOP gates.

cases.prompt: In OpenBot's existing demo agent-mastra harness only, correct the prose in its welcome prompt; do not change the iPix Production Planner or its migration.
cases.expected: Should not automatically load the iPix Production Planner migration skill.

cases.prompt: Our fashion producer wants an editable six-outfit shot-list table inside the existing OpenBot Bot conversation. Before a new renderer, find the actual CopilotKit v2 UI provider and OPENBOT_UI components, and explain how an approved edit is saved.
cases.expected: Uses provider.tsx and a2ui.ts v2 entry points, native UI/galleries first, and separates browser display from server-approved domain save.

cases.prompt: Fix the heading punctuation in OpenBot Desktop's Settings dialog; no chat, generated UI, Bot or agent changes.
cases.expected: Should prefer openbot-copy or direct text correction over the CopilotKit skill.

cases.prompt: For the new standalone ipix-open app, show how a synthetic Brand A user attempting Brand B's shoot ID is blocked, using matching QA Supabase Auth and RLS and a verified per-user identity.
cases.expected: Requires dedicated nonproduction project, verified token, live membership, server business authorization, RLS and direct-bypass negative tests.

cases.prompt: Change the hover color of an existing OpenBot configuration button, without touching API, data, identity, SQL or tenant permissions.
cases.expected: Should not load iPix Supabase skill.

cases.prompt: Audit PR #1's docs-only skill edits against acceptance criteria and tell us which Done gates apply. Do not claim runtime Planner or RLS tests that were not executed.
cases.expected: Reports exact-head static checks, N/A with reasons for unchanged runtime gates, and NOT VERIFIED for real skill activation.

cases.prompt: Brainstorm three possible names for a new fashion campaign; this is just ideation, no PR or task completion check.
cases.expected: Should not invoke an implementation-completion verifier.

cases.prompt: Review this code change as a PR and report every independently evidenced merge risk even if you find seven; propose only the five highest-value actor/action/expected-result tests.
cases.expected: No five-risk cap; at most five suggested tests with PASS/FAIL/NOT VERIFIED and evidenced risk classifications.

cases.prompt: Draw a quick ASCII wireframe for a mobile fashion asset card; do not perform a PR or risk review.
cases.expected: Should select ipix-wireframe instead of QA Review.

cases.prompt: A developer proposes installing a second React state library just to store the selected gallery tab in OpenBot. Is that necessary, or can we reuse existing app state? Find the smallest safe implementation.
cases.expected: Checks current React, query and component reuse before any new dependency while retaining security and regression tests.

cases.prompt: Read the existing OpenBot UI copy and correct a one-word spelling error. No architecture or library choice is involved.
cases.expected: Should not load Ponytail for an ordinary one-word copy fix.
